Instead of watching Netflix tonight… start building something of your own. 💻✨ Here’s how I’d create a digital product using ChatGPT and Canva—step by step. 👇 📌 SAVE these prompts for later! 1️⃣ BUILD YOUR OUTLINE Copy into ChatGPT: “Create an outline for a 10–12 page guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Give me a section-by-section structure with a one-sentence summary for each.” 💡 Choose a specific problem you know how to help someone solve. 2️⃣ WRITE YOUR CONTENT “Write a short, conversational section about [SUBTOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Keep it simple, include one practical example, and stay under 250 words.” ✨ Add your own voice, experience, and tips. Check the facts and make sure the advice is useful! 3️⃣ GIVE IT A NAME “Give me 10 name ideas for a guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Mix clear, descriptive titles with catchy options. Avoid clichés.” 4️⃣ DESIGN IT IN CANVA 🎨 Use Canva’s free plan, search “ebook template,” choose free elements, add your content, and export as a PDF. 5️⃣ GET IT READY TO SELL 🛍️ Choose a storefront, such as Etsy, Stan Store, or Beacons, and check its fees and requirements. Then ask ChatGPT: “Write a four-sentence sales description for [PRODUCT] for [AUDIENCE]. Explain how it helps them [OUTCOME].
